claim_legs.durability: Tracked sources, exact saved join outputs and full input catalog survive checkout. audit.py --verify-saved rederives and compares the saved result; recover.py --verify-saved authenticates saved output bytes. Explicit claim disposition owns the current source watcher.
claim_legs.falsify: Original selection/applicability controls rerun; join controls reject missing or duplicated coverage, wrong outcomes, observer misclassification, root overlap and corrupt historical input/source receipts. Original errno/header auditors remain RED on valid evidence while corrected auditors pass. The separate book watcher rejects changed counts and total-conserving redistribution.
claim_legs.rederive: Exact revision-bound input catalog, independent prospective source and historical Git authentication, complete unique selector domain, original per-case oracles and direct raw-record counts reproduce all selected cases and outcomes.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and required commit hooks must pass before this verified slice is committed.
earlier_falsifiers: Source and exact saved verdicts authenticated; selected per-row oracles rerun. Earlier main routines and their full embedded falsifier loops are not rerun.
scope: Revalidate retained selected safe-call, release-readback and syscall-report cases. Primary coverage and the strong-observer counterexample are disjoint. No fixture, old main, original producer, native process or new test root. Close-error/omission composition, complete release applicability and native lifetime remain separate.
